# Laya for RK3588 / Turing Pi RK1

This archive contains one Rust executable and the project's Apache 2.0 license.
It does not contain Laya model weights, compiled RKNN graphs, the Rockchip
RKNN runtime, or the Mali OpenCL driver. Those components must be
installed separately. See the repository README for setup and environment
variables: https://github.com/elepedus/laya-rk3588-turingpi-rk1

The ARM64 archives target Ubuntu 22.04 or a system with a compatible glibc.
